# Page Metadata

> Cross-cutting how-to-web concern for keeping browser, search, social, structured-data and coding-agent representations of a page factually consistent.

Use Build DNA as the normative reconstruction contract. The inspector and prose teach the concern but do not override the contract.

## Contract

- [Build DNA](./build-dna.json): Canonical reconstruction and consistency contract.
- [LLM-friendly reference](./index.md): Concise explanation.
- [Research](./RESEARCH.md): Sources and scope decisions.
- [Human reference](./): Dogfoods its own metadata.

## Constraints

- Do not add meta keywords as a Google Search optimization.
- Do not describe robots metadata as access control.
- Do not invent canonical/public URLs or structured-data facts.
- Treat llms.txt as an agent-discovery proposal, not a mandatory web standard.
- Keep JSON-LD, Build DNA and demo JSON conceptually separate.
